title: WORLD'S 6TH OATHPLATE KIT COMPLETE (OSRS)
summary: A compilation of Gnomonkey's Yama contract kills from a roughly 20-hour stream in which he completed his Radiant Oathplate kit, which he says was the world's 6th. There is no guide commentary; the video is mostly live reactions to each contract.

outline.text: First contract kill, taking little damage and using Blood Fury healing
Sigil bottom contract completed in 9:39 with two instant mauls
Managing stamina and run energy on later contracts
Line of sight plugin and full mage contract
Contract compared to Kephri Medic that kills you if a swarm goes in
Final contract completed after twenty and a half hours
Trying on the finished Oathplate set

claims.text: Gnomonkey completed his Radiant Oathplate kit as the world's 6th player to do so, in May 2025, after a roughly 20 hour stream.
Gnomonkey says completing all the contracts for the kit took twenty and a half hours of stream.
Gnomonkey calls the Radiant Oathplate kit one of the hardest challenges in the game at release.
Per the description, the launch had many issues, including contracts being impossible to complete without hotfixes.
Gnomonkey says 6th place is good enough for him and refers to himself as a D tier PvMer; he says he will not make a guide on these contracts.
After completion Gnomonkey tried the new Oathplate on with a Torva helmet and a Zek helmet and thought he was third to finish unless someone else had snuck in.
Gnomonkey completed the sigil bottom contract in 9:39 with two instant mauls, which he thought was probably a fairly fast completion; he says the key is keeping run energy high.
On the contract kills Gnomonkey used a stamina potion and a food that gives lots of health and 10 run energy when eaten to keep run energy up.
Gnomonkey used the Line of sight plugin, set to five, for one of the contract kills, which he did in full mage.
Gnomonkey described one contract as Kephri Medic as a contract, except it kills you if a swarm goes in.
Gnomonkey says one contract was one of the easiest of the contracts, and another easier than the previous one.
At completion Gnomonkey got no white Rancour and no pet, only the blue-eyed look he likes, and said a thrall saved his last kill.
